name: GD AUTOPILOT
description: Advanced AI Geometry Dash Level Completion Bot with real-time 240Hz physics prediction, multi-mode controllers, level analysis, adaptive learning, and an in-game Geode control suite.

auto-enable-on-enter.name: Auto-Start AI on Level Enter
auto-enable-on-enter.description: Automatically starts GD AUTOPILOT whenever you enter a level.

show-hud-overlay.name: Show In-Game HUD Overlay
show-hud-overlay.description: Displays live AI activity, current mode, progress bar, and performance stats while playing.

analysis-speed.name: Analysis Speed Level
analysis-speed.description: Controls lookahead depth and simulation frequency (1 = Eco, 2 = Balanced, 3 = Aggressive, 4 = Ultra).

learning-enabled.name: Enable Adaptive Learning
learning-enabled.description: Records attempt outcomes and failure zones to adapt jump timings and reuse successful strategies.

debug-logging.name: Verbose Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Logs detailed AI decisions, physics predictions, and pattern detections to Geode logs and the in-game console.
